data.description: Evil outsiders take damage when they attempt to connect to other planes.
data.name: Painful Anchor

raw_tokens.value: Evil outsiders take damage when they attempt to connect to other planes.

When an evil outsider uses a calling, summoning, or teleportation effect, or any ability that physically transports a creature to or from another plane (such as blink or etherealness) within your anchoring aura, it takes damage equal to 4d8 + %1. This damage comes from holy power and is not subject to damage reduction, energy immunities, or energy resistances.|PainfulAnchorBonusDamage
